description: Skuleberget / Naturum Höga Kusten to Entré Syd Skuleskogens nationalpark. Candidate import from normalized research; verify current notices before publication.

notes: Current section is 10.86 km Skuleberget-Entré Syd, while old sources and OSM relation still describe Skuleberget-Köpmanholmen or old stage numbers.
Hidden Höga Kusten GPX track points match the current Naturkartan route, but metadata/internal track name says Skuleberget-Köpmanholmen.
Naturkartan indicates grill/fireplace at Entré Syd, while national-park service guidance says the nearest fire place is Kälsviken.
Official/field sources mention Käl water/well/pump and FAQ mentions Kallkälla syd Bjestoberget, but section pass found no exact importable coordinates.
Both Skuleberget reserve and Skuleskogen national park affect the section, but only at different parts of the route rather than the whole line.
Stop names vary: Naturum Höga Kusten E4, Skule Naturum E4, Skuleberget Naturum E4 and Skuleberget E4.

facilities.name: Accessible parking toward Kälsviken
facilities.description: Accessible/special parking toward Kälsviken beyond Entré Syd. Special access parking; key must be collected at Naturum and should be arranged ahead.

facilities.name: Naturvatten, Älvdalsbäcken Skuleskogen
facilities.description: Natural water source at Älvdalsbäcken near the final approach toward Skuleskogen/Entré Syd. National park says stream water is untreated and can dry in dry summers. Use boil/filter warning and do not treat as guaranteed potable water.

facilities.name: Entré Syd Skuleskogens nationalpark
facilities.description: South entrance to Skuleskogens nationalpark with information, parking, dry/compost toilets, benches/sheltered seating, waste/bin facilities and rest infrastructure. No food or refill water at the entrance. Do not import an Entré Syd fireplace until the Naturkartan grill/fireplace indication is reconciled with national-park service guidance that names Kälsviken as nearest fire place.

facilities.name: Getsvedjeberget / Predikstolen viewpoint
facilities.description: Viewpoint/cliff feature on Getsvedjeberget, now part of the current route context. Field reports describe a steep, rocky/rooty climb and exposed viewpoint. Cliff exposure; wet rock/root hazard. Not a service facility.

facilities.name: Hillside Kitchen
facilities.description: Food/cafe/restaurant service at the Naturum/Skuleberget start cluster. Opening hours are seasonal and should be checked directly before relying on food service.

facilities.name: Höga Kusten Kajakcenter, Veåsand
facilities.description: Kayak rental/water-access activity point at Veåsand. Useful context/access metadata, not hiker resupply. Activity rental, not a core hiking facility.

facilities.name: Naturum Höga Kusten / Skuleberget start service cluster
facilities.description: Visitor center at the Skuleberget/Naturum start area with information, exhibitions, food/cafe context, toilets, parking and picnic/rest infrastructure. 2026 opening: 2 Apr-21 Jun 10-16, 22 Jun-16 Aug 9-18, 17 Aug-4 Oct 10-16. Water/food/toilet access outside opening hours needs separate verification.

facilities.name: Naturum outside rest area toilets and water tap
facilities.description: Outside rest-area services near Naturum, including toilet and drinking-water tap/picnic infrastructure. Tap coordinate is OSM-sourced. Verify whether the tap is frost-free/year-round before presenting as reliable winter water.
